title: ヴィクトリアマイルにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Victoria Mile, Vodka's first senior goal, is finally here!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Let's get goin'. It's a mile race, so if I'm not careful, it'll be over before I know it.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: There's no time to think about anything durin' the race. But today, I feel like that's actually perfect for me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I need to find my next goal… and my next me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I always feel out what's really important based on instinct.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: The answers come to me during races. It's like…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: When my thoughts disappear and I'm running with all my might, I sorta get this tunnel vision focus.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: For the first time in a while, I'm here with a clear mind. All I need to do is run fast.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: This isn't so bad… Actually, I feel like it might be easier to find answers in times like these.
choice_data_list: All right. Then, let's get searching!
All right. Then, let's get searching!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Right! Like always, I'm gonna give it my all.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Victoria, you might be the goddess of victory, but I'm good on the blessings. I'm winnin' this my way!
